name: Briarvex
page: pp. 26–27, Briarvex and Briarvexes with Class Levels
sourceDistinctions: The original entry lists +4 LA and calls briarvexes generally unsuitable as PCs. Saltburr is built as a classed NPC.
Druid spells do not stack with the racial entangle. CR 6 is an encounter estimate using a nonassociated first class level. The class Hit Die has a recorded roll of 5.

name: Nagatha
sourceDistinctions: The ECL table on p. 204 independently confirms 8 racial HD, +2 LA and base ECL 10. The bite DC is unchanged at 9 total HD. The class Hit Die has a recorded roll of 6.

name: Corruptor of Fate
page: pp. 190–192, Yugoloth, Corruptor of Fate and Corruptors of Fate with Class Levels
sourceDistinctions: Yugoloth is the original source grouping. No parentSpecies link is used for this catalog entry.

The book’s classed assassin example confirms that curse caster level and both racial save DCs key off total HD. The rogue class Hit Die has a recorded roll of 4. The +1 Dexterity increase at 8 HD is included in all affected numbers.

name: Windblade
page: pp. 176–179, Windrazor, Windscythe and Windblades as Characters
sourceDistinctions: Windscythe uses the dedicated p. 179 package’s +5 LA as the primary reading, with the p. 204 ECL table disagreement recorded explicitly. The NPC is Windrazor.
The entry supplies no shaken duration on Fearsome Critical. The NPC uses one round as a declared table ruling. Its class Hit Die has a recorded roll of 5.

name: Varag
page: pp. 168–171, Varag and For Player Characters: The Varag Racial Class
sourceDistinctions: The ECL table on p. 204 confirms base ECL 5. The NPC uses the p. 168 adult monster route and its 60-ft. speed. The p. 171 character progression starts with 40 ft. and has no printed speed increase.
The +1 Strength increase at 4 HD is included. The class Hit Die has a recorded roll of 6.
